title: Counting Stairs
prompt:
**Description:** Count the ways to climb n stairs taking 1 or 2 steps at a time,
modulo 10^9 + 7.

**Input:** One line: n (1 <= n <= 100000).
**Output:** One integer — the number of ways mod 10^9 + 7.

**Example:** `3` -> `3` (1+1+1, 1+2, 2+1).
